user.title: OPCOM Energy
user.description: Get Romanian day-ahead prices directly from OPCOM. No account or API key is required. Prices are wholesale RON/kWh, without supplier charges or taxes. Configure optional tariff formulas after setup.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach OPCOM. Try again later.
error.invalid_data: OPCOM did not return a complete valid schedule for today.

simple.title: Tariff and planning options
simple.description: Each tariff is: spot RON/kWh × multiplier + adder. Defaults equal wholesale spot prices. Enter your own contract parameters; taxes and fees are never assumed. Cheapest windows use the import formula; cheap percentile uses spot prices. These import settings apply only in simple mode; saving does not switch the active mode. Export and planning settings apply in both modes. An active YellowGrid tariff version overrides the simple export formula.

pricing.title: Pricing mode
pricing.description: Simple mode preserves the original formula and settings. Components mode uses dated tariffs at HA-local midnight. Without a covering version the estimated total is unavailable. Raw OPCOM prices stay visible.

tariffs.title: Tariff versions
tariffs.description: Each version contains before-VAT energy settings, components and VAT. Edits are committed only when you choose Save tariff.

add_tariff.title: Add tariff version
add_tariff.description: The YellowGrid chart estimate uses import cap 0.55, export floor 0.50, commission 25% and Delgaz distribution 0.38791 RON/kWh. Distribution is inferred from the chart, not confirmed for your contract. Choose the invoice preset separately for invoice rates. Verify CfD VAT.

delete_tariff.title: Delete tariff version
delete_tariff.description: Selecting a date deletes that version and saves immediately. This can remove tariff coverage. Other versions are preserved.

version.title: Before-VAT energy settings
version.description: Linear model: OPCOM × multiplier + adder. YellowGrid: import energy is min(cap, OPCOM + (cap − OPCOM) × commission/100), then multiplier and adder, before VAT. Export uses the floor and commission without import charges.

tariff_details.title: Tariff components
tariff_details.description: Edit multiple components before saving. The invoice template assumes 21% CfD VAT and marks it unverified; check your contract and edit it. Rounded zero invoice VAT does not establish exemption.

edit_component.title: Choose component
edit_component.description: Select a component by its name.

remove_component.title: Choose component
remove_component.description: Select a component by its name.

component.title: Per-kWh component
component.description: Rate is before VAT in RON/kWh. Set VAT to zero only when appropriate. Disabled components do not contribute to the total.

error.invalid_options: Use finite numbers, multipliers 0–100, percentile 0–100, and a window of 15–1440 minutes divisible by 15.
error.duplicate_date: A tariff version already starts on that date.
error.invalid_tariff: Check unique dates/names, finite values, multiplier 0–100, VAT 0–100 and rates between -10000 and 10000.

abort.no_tariffs: No tariff versions exist. Add one first.
abort.no_components: This version has no components. Add one first.

get_prices.name: Get prices
get_prices.description: Return cached published intervals for a local calendar day; completeness is explicit. No network request is made.

get_cheapest_window.name: Get cheapest window
get_cheapest_window.description: Find the globally cheapest contiguous future window among published prices.
